title: The Last Train
description: A commuter was robbed on a nearly empty platform just before midnight. One witness remembers a distinctive red coat.

truth.sequence: Ravi followed Arun onto Platform 6 and took the wallet before escaping through the maintenance stairwell.

alibi.claim: I was at the station cafe until midnight.

evidence.name: Cafe Receipt
evidence.description: The cafe receipt shows Ravi's purchase at 23:37, but no later activity.

evidence.name: Red Coat Witness
evidence.description: A witness saw a red jacket leaving Platform 6 at 23:55, matching Ravi's jacket.

evidence.name: Maintenance Camera
evidence.description: A partial camera frame captures Ravi entering the maintenance stairwell at 23:54.

opening_statement: I was just waiting for a coffee. I never went down to Platform 6.
